paper_id: corpus-基于深度学习的四川盆地丘陵区县域耕地遥感识别研究
title: 基于深度学习的四川盆地丘陵区县域耕地遥感识别研究

novelty_points.claim: 面向四川盆地丘陵县域耕地识别，将高分六号影像的光谱与地形特征融合后用于UNet++耕地提取，并对比仅使用光谱特征的方案。
novelty_points.claim_en: For cultivated land identification in a hilly county of the Sichuan Basin, applies UNet++ to fused spectral and terrain features from GF-6 imagery and compares it with a spectral-only approach.
technical_features: 以高分六号高分辨率遥感影像开展三台县耕地识别。
比较UNet++、DeeplabV3+、UNet、PSPNet、随机森林与SinoLC-1产品的识别效果。
将光谱与地形特征融合输入UNet++，并与仅光谱输入进行对比。
technical_features_en: Uses high-resolution GF-6 imagery for cultivated land identification in Santai County.
Compares UNet++, DeeplabV3+, UNet, PSPNet, random forest, and the SinoLC-1 land cover product.
Fuses spectral and terrain features for UNet++ and compares this with spectral-only input.
